Yazboz Guru: Terms of Use

Last updated: 24 October 2026

These terms apply when you use Yazboz Guru, made by Goal Guru. By using the app you agree to them.

Apple's licence

The app is licensed to you under Apple's Licensed Application End User License Agreement (Standard EULA). These terms add to it; where they differ, Apple's EULA comes first for anything about the licence itself.

Premium subscriptions

  • Yazboz Guru Premium is an auto-renewing subscription, monthly or yearly. The price is shown in the app before you buy.
  • Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase, or at the end of the free trial if the plan has one.
  • The subscription renews automatically at the end of each period unless you cancel at least 24 hours before it ends; the renewal is charged within the 24 hours before the period ends.
  • You can manage or cancel it any time in your Apple Account settings (Settings › your name › Subscriptions), or from Premium › Manage subscription in the app.
  • If a free trial is offered, any unused part of it ends when you buy a subscription.
  • Keeping score is always free. Premium adds the features listed in the app; if Premium ends, the app keeps working with the free features.
  • Refunds are handled by Apple: reportaproblem.apple.com.

Names you share

When you share a tournament or a live game, the names you enter can be seen by everyone who has its code or link. We have no tolerance for objectionable content. You agree not to enter names that:

  • are offensive, hateful, discriminatory, threatening or harassing,
  • are sexual or violent,
  • pretend to be someone else, or share someone's personal details without their consent,
  • break the law or someone else's rights.

Names pass a word filter, and every shared tournament and game has a Report button. We review reports within 24 hours, and we may remove content, take a tournament or game offline, and refuse further sharing from those who break these rules. You can stop seeing a tournament or game you follow at any time.

The app as it is

Yazboz Guru helps you keep score; the rules your table plays by are up to you. We work hard to keep it accurate and available, but the app and its online features are provided as they are, without guarantees, as far as the law allows. Shared tournaments and games are deleted from the server after the periods in our privacy policy.

Trademarks

Uno is a trademark of Mattel. Yahtzee is a trademark of Hasbro. Catan, 7 Wonders, Carcassonne and Ticket to Ride are trademarks of their owners. Yazboz Guru is an independent score-keeping app and isn't affiliated with, sponsored or endorsed by them.

Changes and law

We may update these terms; the date at the top shows the latest version. Dutch law applies, without taking away the protection the law of your own country gives you as a consumer.
